onboarding.title: Welcome
onboarding.intro: What would you like to do? You can do both later — the tabs are at the bottom.
onboarding.advertiserText: Set a budget — creators make videos, and you pay only for the views they get.
onboarding.creatorText: Take an order, post on your TikTok, Instagram or YouTube — get paid in USDT for views.

advertiser.title: How to order ads
steps: Describe the task and set a budget
A moderator reviews the order and sets the rate per 1,000 views
Creators post videos on their accounts — you pay only for views
When the budget runs out, the order closes by itself — you never overspend

creator.title: How to earn
steps: Post a video on your social media — you have 7 days
Once it reaches the view threshold, send us the link
A moderator checks the video and we pay you; 5 days later we top up for new views

onboarding.note: The parties don't see each other's contacts: questions, disputes and payments go through support (menu ⋯ → “Settings”).
